chapter: Telephone reels: blues and Bessie Smith
title: Never played in speakeasies; listening at the Cotton Club
summary: He did not play in bands or speakeasies; at clubs he listened and drew ideas from others.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: Uh-huh. Do you know what I never asked
you? I know you didn't play in bands and things like that.
But when you were trying to make your way along, did you ever play in speakeasies?
Uh-huh. And -- but -- so then when things were at the Cotton Club and the other places, your music was being played, but --
Yeah, say, take the Cotton Club, you know, or other places. When your music was played, you were -- you certainly got a lot of inspiration being around other musicians, right?
Uh-huh. So then what would you do, just sit down and jam afterwards?
I'd just sit down and listen like any other little boy would. If they asked me (inaudible), why I'd listen, because it's through other ideas that you get ideas of your own.
So when I found one of those guys who really had it, oh, it was a pleasure to listen.
Yeah, it was the appreciation of it, uh-huh.
